notes: B-pwa and B-auth fully implemented. (D1) vite-plugin-pwa@0.20.5 resolved (Node 20.0.0 compatible; @vite-pwa/assets-generator skipped — requires engines>=20.9.0 under engine-strict). pngjs@7.0.0 used via scripts/gen-icons.mjs for icon generation. (D2) idb@8.0.3 + fake-indexeddb@6.2.5 added for IndexedDB refresh token store (stay-signed-in flow). (D3) Single-flight mutex via module-level `let refreshInFlight: Promise<boolean>|null` in refresh.ts; concurrent 401s share one in-flight promise — exactly one /auth/refresh call. (D4) Silent refresh is driver opt-in: enableSilentRefresh('/d/login') called from useDriverLogin on success AND from DriverLayout on mount (survives page reload); dispatcher /x path never calls it — byte-identical to prior behaviour. (D5) DriverLayout omits useFleetHub (deferred to B-home per spec). (D6) useLogin.ts updated to role-based navigate (Driver→/d, else→/x) — existing dispatcher tests still pass (mock role='Admin'→/x). (D7) devOptions.enabled=false in vite.config.ts ensures SW never registers in dev mode (Playwright boots dev mode); SW only emitted at build. (D8) Touch targets: theme.touchTargets.min=48px (permission priming), theme.touchTargets.primary=64px (login submit). (D9) resolvedVersions: vite-plugin-pwa=0.20.5, pngjs=7.0.0, idb=8.0.3, fake-indexeddb=6.2.5. SW scope proof: dist/sw.js contains denylist for /api and /hubs; manifest.webmanifest name='Taxi Řidič', start_url='/d'. runtimeCaching=[] confirmed.
